name: Soča Valley in a day
description_md:
The Soča Valley in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk located in SI. This route covers 14.4 km of walking between stops.

The itinerary includes 5 sightseeing stops anchored in the city. The full day requires 8.0 hours to complete, which includes visit time at each stop.
